entries.title: A crewmate stuck at its provider stops retrying and your first mate steps in
entries.body: When a provider refuses a crewmate's request the same way three times in a row, the app stops retrying, keeps the crewmate's message and marks the task Stuck at its provider. Your first mate then steers it, restarts it in a fresh conversation or moves it to another model. While the app retries a failing provider, Activity shows one line for the outage that says the app tries again on its own, and the task reads Retrying at its provider.

picture.alt: A task's record says Stuck at its provider and explains that the app stopped retrying and the first mate is choosing what to do
